svg.title: Short-range scattering is more frequent at higher energy but the path length is constant
svg.desc: In an isotropic 3D parabolic band with fixed mass, impurity density and constant Born amplitude, the final-state DOS and scattering rate are proportional to sqrt(K). The transport mean free path is constant because the speed increases by the same factor as the rate. The marked reference energy is 50 meV.
svg.text: More scattering per second, not per meter
3D parabolic band · fixed mass and impurity model
